newsitem.title: JAPAN: Asahi Chemical, DuPont tie up over nylon material.
newsitem.headline: Asahi Chemical, DuPont tie up over nylon material.

text.p: DuPont Co will provide a total of 250,000 tonnes of hexamethylenediamine, a material to make nylon fibre and resin, to Asahi Chemical Industry Co Ltd over 16 years, the two firms said on Thursday.
They had been in discussions over cooperation in the nylon business since 1993 and the agreement was the outcome of the negotiations, the two companies said in a joint statement.
The agreement will ensure procurement of the material that Asahi Chemical needs to expand its nylon business, which Asahi considers to be one of its core businesses, the statement said.
